name: Holiday Hearth
description: Chestnuts, tinsel and a warm glow on the screen: Miracle on 34th Street, Christmas in Connecticut, The Bishop's Wife, Beyond Tomorrow, March of the Wooden Soldiers and Santa Claus Conquers the Martians, plus Fleischer's Rudolph, the Grinch, A Charlie Brown Christmas and a sackful of 1950s Christmas episodes from Jack Benny, Burns and Allen, Ozzie and Harriet, Dragnet and the Beverly Hillbillies. Sunday evenings at 7:00 bring A Christmas Carol in a different version each week (Alastair Sim, Seymour Hicks, Vincent Price, Mr. Magoo and more), and the Rankin/Bass specials air Saturdays at 6:00 pm.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 37 hours of hand-listed Christmas features, cartoons, TV episodes and variety specials (1901-1979) in rotation, plus seven Christmas Carol adaptations (Sunday slot) and 13 Rankin/Bass specials (Saturday slot). Excluded: yule-log and fireplace loops, colorized versions (including the colorized Bishop's Wife and The Christmas Wish edit of The Great Rupert), foreign-language dubs (Santa Claus 1959, the Polish It's a Wonderful Life; no clean complete English copy of It's a Wonderful Life was found), modern specials and compilations, incomplete copies, and cartoons with racial caricature (The Shanty Where Santy Claus Lives).
